entry.title: Sapa Rasa Sayang Halal Buffet
entry.notes: 775 Điện Biên Phủ. Halal Malaysian, Indonesian and Vietnamese buffet; rice, curry, grilled meats and desserts. Go at lunch; buffet may end before closing. Restaurant hours 07:00–21:00. Pin approximate from official website embedded map center; exact Google listing linked. Solo price not confirmed.
